# AVR, checked against avr-elf-as (GNU binutils 2.47) with no -mmcu, which
# assembles for the AVR2 instruction set: no jmp, call, movw, mul or break.
# One statement per line. Generated from every row of the opcode table,
# include/opcode/avr.h, and kept to what the reference accepts; avr51.txt,
# avrxmega.txt and avrtiny.txt hold what only a larger or different core has.
#
# A branch to a label is relocated even within its section (linker
# relaxation), so its field is zero on both sides and says nothing here; the
# branches below go to plain numbers, which GNU as resolves, measured from the
# start of the section. avr-relocs.txt and tools/flat-diff/avr.txt check the
# rest.
#
# Not here, because rsasm refuses on purpose what the reference accepts with
# a warning (tests/avr.rs covers them): an ldi constant below -255, an
# AVR-tiny lds/sts address outside 0x40-0xbf, and lo8(gs()) of a number,
# which is a fatal error there.

# ---- no operands -----------------------------------------------------------
clc
clh
cli
cln
cls
clt
clv
clz
sec
seh
sei
sen
ses
set
sev
sez

# ---- SREG bit set and clear ------------------------------------------------
bclr 0
bclr 1
bclr 5
bclr 7
bset 0
bset 1
bset 5
bset 7

# ---- no operands -----------------------------------------------------------
icall
ijmp

# ---- program memory load ---------------------------------------------------
lpm
lpm r0, Z
lpm r0, z
lpm r5, Z
lpm r5, z
lpm r16, Z
lpm r16, z
lpm r31, Z
lpm r31, z

# ---- no operands -----------------------------------------------------------
nop
ret
reti
sleep
wdr
